imagePolicy.summary: No third-party product photos are bundled or hotlinked. Wikimedia Commons forbids action-figure photos as derivative works (commons.wikimedia.org Category:Action figures). Retailer and fan-site photo terms do not permit scraping/hotlinking. Every catalog entry uses an original ShelfTrack-generated fallback card (line color + initials). Users may attach their own photo of their figure (camera/file, stored locally only).
